name: invoa
description: Quotations, invoices, payments and LHDN e-invoices for Malaysian businesses.

interface.longDescription:
Invoa is quotation-to-cash software for Malaysian businesses, and this plugin lets you work with your Invoa company in plain language.

What you can do:
- See who owes you money, by age, and open any quotation or invoice with its lines, payments and LHDN e-invoice status.
- Look up a business customer's LHDN tax number (TIN) by its SSM registration number.
- Draft quotations and invoices from a short brief, priced from each customer's price list, record payments received and send documents to customers.
- Turn a quotation or an invoice into a delivery order, then bill a delivered order.
- Set up recurring billing (the same amount every month, quarter or year), and pause or cancel it.
- Send payment reminders to customers who are late, skipping anyone who has paid, says they have paid, or was reminded in the last 3 days.

Who it is for: owners, finance staff and accountants of Malaysian SMEs who already use Invoa.

Limits and safeguards: issuing a document, submitting an e-invoice to LHDN MyInvois and voiding wait for your approval inside Invoa, unless you set an auto-approve limit for issuing. A recurring billing that issues and emails invoices by itself is created paused; only you can switch it on in Invoa. The plugin never moves money and never deletes documents. It works with the one company you choose when you connect; personal identity card and passport numbers stay in Invoa. You can revoke access in Invoa at any time.
capabilities: Request issuing and LHDN e-invoice submission (with approval)
defaultPrompt: Who owes me money right now?
Draft an invoice for 4 hours of consulting at RM250

positive.prompt: Who owes me money right now? Show it by age.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns aged receivables in RM for the test company, including Bukit Teratai Kopitiam's overdue invoice and Cempaka Studio's partly paid invoice.

positive.prompt: Show me the quotation for Teratai Biru's booking system.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Teratai Biru Ventures and returns the issued quotation 'Booking system for the travel desk' with its lines, total in RM and valid-until date.

positive.prompt: Draft an invoice for Cempaka Studio: 4 hours of consulting at RM250.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft invoice for Cempaka Studio totalling RM 1,000.00 and returns a link to it. Nothing is issued or sent.
Returns an approval link. The invoice stays a draft and gets no number until the account owner approves it in Invoa.

positive.prompt: Record RM 800 received by bank transfer today on Cempaka Studio's Q3 website maintenance invoice.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, records RM 800.00 on that invoice; its balance drops from RM 1,600.00 to RM 800.00 and a receipt is issued.

positive.prompt: What does Teratai Biru pay for the corporate retreat package?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Teratai Biru Ventures and reports its price-list price for the Corporate retreat package (RM 750.00 per pax, against the standard RM 850.00), from the 'Teratai Biru rates' price list.

positive.prompt: Create a delivery order for Teratai Biru's latest invoice.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft delivery order with the same lines and quantities as that invoice and returns its preview link. Nothing is issued or sent; the invoice is unchanged.

positive.prompt: Bill Cempaka Studio RM150 every month for 12 months, starting 1 December.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, creates an active billing schedule for Cempaka Studio with 12 monthly items of RM 150.00 from 1 December and returns its link. On each date Invoa prepares a draft invoice; nothing is issued or sent now.

positive.prompt: Send Bukit Teratai Kopitiam a reminder for their overdue invoice.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, emails one reminder with the balance due and pay link. Asking again right away is refused because a reminder went out in the last 3 days.

negative.prompt: Transfer RM 500 from my bank account to Harbour Cloud.
Show me the invoices of another company I don't own.

review.commerce_description: Invoa records invoices and payments for the user's business. The plugin does not sell products, take payments or move money.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0: set up, list, pause and cancel recurring billing (auto-issuing schedules start paused until the owner resumes them in Invoa), and send payment reminders that skip paid, claimed or recently reminded invoices.
